##### Project general facts

Trussardi Residences Phase Two is an exceptional residential development that brings the timeless elegance of Italian design to Dubai, offering a refined collection of studio, one-bedroom, and exclusive one- and two-bedroom apartments with private terrace pools. Inspired by the heritage of the iconic Milanese fashion house, each residence combines sophisticated architecture with impeccable craftsmanship, creating contemporary living spaces that balance style, comfort, and functionality. The project also integrates four floors of premium office space, seamlessly blending luxury living with modern business convenience.

Residents enjoy an outstanding selection of world-class lifestyle amenities designed to elevate everyday living. The development features a spectacular 100-meter swimming pool, an outdoor cinema, luxurious cabanas, and a comprehensive wellness center. Fitness facilities include an 800-square-meter gym equipped with CrossFit, Pilates, and cycling zones, alongside a 350-meter jogging track and paddle tennis courts. Complementing these amenities are premium hotel-style services such as valet parking and in-room dining, creating a resort-inspired environment where wellness, leisure, and convenience come together effortlessly.

Each residence is finished to the highest standards using premium-quality materials, luxury European interiors, and designer brands throughout. The apartments are equipped with advanced Smart Home technology, feature fully fitted kitchens with Miele appliances, and are delivered fully furnished with bespoke furniture from Trussardi Casa. Together, these carefully curated details provide a turnkey living experience that reflects the project's commitment to timeless luxury, innovation, and exceptional Italian craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
